question: How many total customers are in the database?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers FROM customers;

question: What is the total revenue generated from all completed orders?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS total_revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed';

question: List all customers from California who signed up in 2024.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, email, city FROM customers WHERE state = 'California' AND strftime('%Y', signup_date) = '2024' LIMIT 100;

question: What is the average retail price across all products?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS average_price FROM products;

question: How many orders are in each order status?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY order_count DESC;

question: Find the top 10 most expensive products in the catalog.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT product_id, name, price, cost FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Count the number of customers in each loyalty tier.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT loyalty_tier, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY loyalty_tier ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

question: What is the total inventory stock quantity stored in each warehouse location?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT warehouse_location, SUM(stock_quantity) AS total_stock FROM inventory GROUP BY warehouse_location ORDER BY total_stock DESC;

question: What is the distribution of orders by payment method?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM orders GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

question: How many customer reviews received a 5-star rating?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS five_star_reviews FROM reviews WHERE rating = 5;

question: What are the top 5 product categories by total sales revenue?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.total_price), 2) AS total_revenue FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which 10 products have generated the highest revenue?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.name AS product_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.total_price), 2) AS revenue, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Show the average order value (AOV) and order count by customer segment.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.segment, ROUND(AVG(o.total_amount), 2) AS avg_order_value, COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;

question: List all suppliers along with the number of products they supply and their supplier rating.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT s.name AS supplier_name, s.country, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count, s.rating FROM suppliers s JOIN products p ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.name, s.country, s.rating ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT 20;

question: Find the top 5 countries by total completed order spend.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What is the average review rating and review count for each product category?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating, COUNT(r.review_id) AS review_count FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY avg_rating DESC;

question: List the top 5 customers with the most completed orders and their total spend.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS customer_name, c.email, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id, customer_name, c.email ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Show the breakdown of payment methods used by Platinum loyalty tier customers.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT o.payment_method, COUNT(o.order_id) AS usage_count, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_spend FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.loyalty_tier = 'Platinum' GROUP BY o.payment_method ORDER BY usage_count DESC;

question: Find products with stock below their reorder level along with category and warehouse.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.name AS product_name, c.name AS category, i.stock_quantity, i.reorder_level, i.warehouse_location FROM inventory i JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE i.stock_quantity <= i.reorder_level ORDER BY i.stock_quantity ASC LIMIT 20;

question: Calculate the total discount amount given per product category.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.name AS category, ROUND(SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity * oi.discount_rate), 2) AS total_discount FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY total_discount DESC;

question: What is the monthly sales revenue trend for completed orders in 2024?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS monthly_revenue, COUNT(order_id) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2024' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month ASC;

question: Compare quarterly completed revenue between 2023 and 2024.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', order_date) AS year, CASE WHEN strftime('%m', order_date) IN ('01','02','03') THEN 'Q1' WHEN strftime('%m', order_date) IN ('04','05','06') THEN 'Q2' WHEN strftime('%m', order_date) IN ('07','08','09') THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END AS quarter, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND strftime('%Y', order_date) IN ('2023', '2024') GROUP BY year, quarter ORDER BY year, quarter;

question: What is the day of week distribution of completed order volume?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT CASE CAST(strftime('%w', order_date) AS INTEGER) WHEN 0 THEN 'Sunday' WHEN 1 THEN 'Monday' WHEN 2 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN 3 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN 4 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN 5 THEN 'Friday' ELSE 'Saturday' END AS day_of_week, COUNT(*) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS total_revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY strftime('%w', order_date) ORDER BY CAST(strftime('%w', order_date) AS INTEGER);

question: Find customer signup growth month-by-month for 2024.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', signup_date) AS signup_month, COUNT(customer_id) AS new_customers FROM customers WHERE strftime('%Y', signup_date) = '2024' GROUP BY signup_month ORDER BY signup_month ASC;

question: What was the daily revenue during Black Friday week in November 2024 (Nov 24 to Nov 30)?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DATE(order_date) AS order_day, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS daily_revenue, COUNT(order_id) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-11-24' AND order_date <= '2024-11-30 23:59:59' AND status = 'completed' GROUP BY order_day ORDER BY order_day ASC;

question: What is the average number of days between customer signup and their first completed order?
ground_truth_sql: WITH first_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, MIN(order_date) AS first_order_date FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(fo.first_order_date) - JULIANDAY(c.signup_date)), 2) AS avg_days_to_first_order FROM customers c JOIN first_orders fo ON c.customer_id = fo.customer_id;

question: Show monthly refund rates (refunded orders / total orders) for 2024.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'refunded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refunded_orders, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'refunded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS refund_rate_pct FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2024' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month ASC;

question: Find the peak ordering hour of the day across all completed transactions.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT strftime('%H', order_date) AS hour_of_day, COUNT(*) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS total_revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY hour_of_day ORDER BY hour_of_day ASC;

question: Show annual revenue and order volume from 2022 to 2025.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', order_date) AS year, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS annual_revenue, COUNT(order_id) AS total_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND strftime('%Y', order_date) BETWEEN '2022' AND '2025' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year ASC;

question: What is the total revenue generated in the last 30 days of the recorded dataset?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS revenue_last_30_days, COUNT(order_id) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= (SELECT DATETIME(MAX(order_date), '-30 days') FROM orders) AND status = 'completed';

tier: Tier 4: Complex Window Functions, CTEs & Quartiles
question: Rank product categories by total profit margin.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.total_price), 2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(SUM(p.cost * oi.quantity), 2) AS total_cost, ROUND(SUM(oi.total_price) - SUM(p.cost * oi.quantity), 2) AS total_profit, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (SUM(oi.total_price) - SUM(p.cost * oi.quantity)) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name;

tier: Tier 4: Complex Window Functions, CTEs & Quartiles
question: Find the top 3 best-selling products within each product category by revenue.
ground_truth_sql: WITH ranked_products AS (SELECT c.name AS category_name, p.name AS product_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.total_price), 2) AS product_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.total_price) DESC) AS rank_in_category FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name, p.product_id, p.name) SELECT category_name, product_name, product_revenue, rank_in_category FROM ranked_products WHERE rank_in_category <= 3 ORDER BY category_name, rank_in_category;

tier: Tier 4: Complex Window Functions, CTEs & Quartiles
question: Calculate the cumulative running total of revenue for 2024 by month.
ground_truth_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS monthly_rev FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2024' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, monthly_rev, ROUND(SUM(monthly_rev) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS cumulative_revenue FROM monthly ORDER BY month ASC;

tier: Tier 4: Complex Window Functions, CTEs & Quartiles
question: Calculate customer repeat purchase rate (customers with more than 1 completed order vs total).
ground_truth_sql: WITH customer_order_counts AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(order_id) AS orders_count FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_purchasing_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN orders_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_customers, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN orders_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS repeat_purchase_rate_pct FROM customer_order_counts;

tier: Tier 4: Complex Window Functions, CTEs & Quartiles
question: Find the 3-month moving average of monthly sales revenue in 2024.
ground_truth_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2024' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, revenue, ROUND(AVG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS moving_avg_3m FROM monthly ORDER BY month ASC;

tier: Tier 4: Complex Window Functions, CTEs & Quartiles
question: Identify customers who placed an order in both 2023 and 2024.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS customer_name, c.email FROM customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2023' AND o.status = 'completed') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2024' AND o.status = 'completed') LIMIT 20;

tier: Tier 4: Complex Window Functions, CTEs & Quartiles
question: Find the month-over-month revenue growth percentage for 2024.
ground_truth_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2024' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, revenue, LAG(revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_revenue, ROUND(100.0 * (revenue - LAG(revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS mom_growth_pct FROM monthly ORDER BY month ASC;

tier: Tier 4: Complex Window Functions, CTEs & Quartiles
question: Group customers into spend quartiles (NTILE 4) and show the average spend per quartile.
ground_truth_sql: WITH cust_spend AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(total_amount) AS total_spend, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY SUM(total_amount) ASC) AS spend_quartile FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT spend_quartile, COUNT(customer_id) AS customers_in_quartile, ROUND(AVG(total_spend), 2) AS avg_spend, ROUND(MIN(total_spend), 2) AS min_spend, ROUND(MAX(total_spend), 2) AS max_spend FROM cust_spend GROUP BY spend_quartile ORDER BY spend_quartile;

tier: Tier 4: Complex Window Functions, CTEs & Quartiles
question: Calculate the running percentage of total 2024 revenue contributed by each product category.
ground_truth_sql: WITH cat_sales AS (SELECT c.name AS category, ROUND(SUM(oi.total_price), 2) AS cat_revenue FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2024' GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name) SELECT category, cat_revenue, ROUND(100.0 * cat_revenue / SUM(cat_revenue) OVER (), 2) AS pct_of_total, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(cat_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY cat_revenue DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) / SUM(cat_revenue) OVER (), 2) AS cumulative_pct FROM cat_sales ORDER BY cat_revenue DESC;

tier: Tier 4: Complex Window Functions, CTEs & Quartiles
question: Find the top 5 customers with the highest increase in order spend from 2023 to 2024.
ground_truth_sql: WITH spend_by_year AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2023' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS spend_2023, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2024' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS spend_2024 FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND strftime('%Y', order_date) IN ('2023', '2024') GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS customer_name, ROUND(s.spend_2023, 2) AS spend_2023, ROUND(s.spend_2024, 2) AS spend_2024, ROUND(s.spend_2024 - s.spend_2023, 2) AS spend_growth FROM spend_by_year s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE s.spend_2023 > 0 ORDER BY spend_growth DESC LIMIT 5;

tier: Tier 5: Multi-Hop Business KPIs & Operational Metrics
question: What is the Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) distribution across loyalty tiers?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.loyalty_tier, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count, ROUND(AVG(customer_totals.lifetime_spend), 2) AS avg_clv, ROUND(MAX(customer_totals.lifetime_spend), 2) AS max_clv FROM customers c JOIN (SELECT customer_id, SUM(total_amount) AS lifetime_spend FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY customer_id) customer_totals ON c.customer_id = customer_totals.customer_id GROUP BY c.loyalty_tier ORDER BY avg_clv DESC;

tier: Tier 5: Multi-Hop Business KPIs & Operational Metrics
question: Identify products with high review ratings (>= 4.5 stars) but low inventory (< 25 units).
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.name AS product_name, c.name AS category, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating, COUNT(r.review_id) AS review_count, i.stock_quantity, i.warehouse_location FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id JOIN reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id JOIN inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name, c.name, i.stock_quantity, i.warehouse_location HAVING AVG(r.rating) >= 4.5 AND i.stock_quantity < 25 ORDER BY avg_rating DESC, i.stock_quantity ASC LIMIT 20;

tier: Tier 5: Multi-Hop Business KPIs & Operational Metrics
question: What is the average number of items and unique products per order by customer segment?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.segment, ROUND(AVG(order_stats.total_items), 2) AS avg_items_per_order, ROUND(AVG(order_stats.unique_products), 2) AS avg_unique_products_per_order FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_items, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS unique_products FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) order_stats ON o.order_id = order_stats.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.segment;

tier: Tier 5: Multi-Hop Business KPIs & Operational Metrics
question: Find the top 5 suppliers whose products have generated the highest net profit.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT s.name AS supplier_name, s.country, ROUND(SUM(oi.total_price), 2) AS gross_sales, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * p.cost), 2) AS total_cost, ROUND(SUM(oi.total_price - (oi.quantity * p.cost)), 2) AS net_profit FROM suppliers s JOIN products p ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.name, s.country ORDER BY net_profit DESC LIMIT 5;

tier: Tier 5: Multi-Hop Business KPIs & Operational Metrics
question: Calculate shipping cost and tax percentage relative to gross order value by shipping country.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT shipping_country, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS gross_sales, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(shipping_cost) / SUM(total_amount), 2) AS shipping_pct, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(tax_amount) / SUM(total_amount), 2) AS tax_pct FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY shipping_country ORDER BY gross_sales DESC;
